verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents domain-specific rules that act automatically on transaction events. In 3D Secure, a rule can force a challenge above an amount threshold, and the platform also lets you block specific merchants, categories or merchant IDs. There is no evidence of a general-purpose, user-defined event→action rules engine; the rules shown are narrow fraud and authorization controls. Missing for 10: a general rules/automation builder, configurable triggers across event types, custom action definitions, and documentation depth or independent corroboration.
